plugins.name: entrepreneur-skills
plugins.description: Is this idea worth it? Market sizing, customer interviews and cheap demand tests for founders, plus the shared business file and humanizer the other repos use.

plugins.name: biz-ready-skills
plugins.description: Turn an idea into a business that makes money: competitors, a board review, the offer, marketing, brand, operations, funding, the pitch and a dated launch.

plugins.name: biz-boost-skills
plugins.description: Get customers as a solo founder or small local business: find leads, research them, write outreach, prep calls, follow up and send proposals. No CRM needed.

plugins.name: mimic-skills
plugins.description: Build a better version of a competitor: map what they do, read what their customers hate, then plan, build, test, launch and ship your own, clean room.

plugins.name: linkedin-boost-skills
plugins.description: Claude skills that help a founder grow on LinkedIn across several businesses: posts, plans, hooks, DMs, comments, replies, inbox, carousels, profile and audits. Skills write; you post.

plugins.name: instagram-boost-skills
plugins.description: Instagram skills for founders with one or more businesses: weekly plans, carousels, stories, DMs, profile, comments, replies, repurposing and monthly audits. Local business mode. You post everything yourself.

plugins.name: multimedia-skills
plugins.description: Make the images and videos for your business: AI images and clips with a spend cap, transcripts, launch promos, talking-head cards and YouTube.

plugins.name: productivity-skills
plugins.description: Run several small ventures and school at once without dropping things: one task list, one weekly review, people, decisions and hand-offs in plain files.

plugins.name: video-boost-skills
plugins.description: Find what makes short and long videos work right now for your topic, turn it into a dated checklist with sources, and score your own video against it before you post.
